evidence_slice: Gedling Borough Council's Local Planning Document (Part 2 Local Plan) was adopted on 18 July 2018. Policy LPD 64 lists H1 - Rolleston Drive as a residential allocation for approximately 140 homes. Gedling Borough Council's authority-hosted OpenData FeatureServer LPD18_Housing_Allocation exposes layer 0, 'Policies LPD 64 - LPD 70 - Housing Allocation', as polygon data in British National Grid EPSG:27700.
binding_method: authority-hosted adopted housing-allocation polygon layer plus exact Local Planning Document identifier; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: Official council policy page/PDF and GIS service were accessed through public web transport; raw exact H1 query bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
license: Publicly accessible Gedling Borough Council planning document and OpenData FeatureServer; layer-specific reuse licence not stated in the public service metadata
